video.share.title: Send this feedback to the Heptabase Explainer Studio team?
video.share.consent: It helps improve how the videos teach and how the tools work. The team uses it only inside Heptabase and never to train AI models.
video.share.also: the comments and ratings you shared before, with any later edits; the agent's notes on how it handled each comment and the tool limits it recorded; frames of the video a few seconds around each comment; the script and timeline of each delivery; the series plan; the Explainer Studio version and operating system; the time, tokens and estimated narration cost of making the series plan and this episode (numbers only).
